intro: Darnassus Marzipan is a festive confectionery crafted in the night elven capital for the autumn celebration of Hallow's End. Innkeepers in Darnassus hand it out to trick-or-treaters willing to dance for their sweet reward.

sections.t: A Taste of the World Tree
p: During Hallow's End, the capital cities of the Alliance take part in lighthearted trick-or-treat traditions. While the dwarves offer sharp mints and Stormwind crafts chewy nougat, the innkeepers of Darnassus prepare delicate marzipan for visitors. Obtaining a piece requires visitors to showcase a bit of festive spirit—specifically, dancing on command for the innkeeper. The confection is one of four regional treats sought by young Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind's Cathedral Square who cannot go out to collect sweets himself.
